"""Writes the status records the Python applier publishes for fixed scenarios,
as testdata/records_golden.json (the values are the records as JSON text; the
Go test normalizes timestamps). Run from the repository root at the commit
before the Go port, with a stub pytest module on the path (test_runtime and
its siblings import it). Kept as text so nothing treats it as Python source."""
import json, sys, tempfile, copy, dataclasses
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'path/to/stub-pytest'); sys.path.insert(0, '.'); sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
import test_runtime as tr
import test_pia as tp
import test_nordvpn_applier as tn
import test_egress as te
import test_gluetun_applier as tg
import test_gluetun_transition as tt
import test_sidecar_applier as ts
from applier.apply import Applier
from molebridge import providers
from molebridge.state import now_iso, write_json_atomic

out = {}

def runtime():
    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
    write_json_atomic(tmp/'applier'/'relays.json', {'fetched_at': now_iso(), 'relays': {tr.HOST: tr.ENTRY}})
    kernel = tr.Kernel()
    app = Applier(tmp, tr.CONFIG, run=kernel.run, clock=lambda: kernel.now, sleep=kernel.sleep, boot_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa')
    app.next_catalog = float('inf')
    return app, kernel

app, k = runtime(); out['mullvad_inspect'] = app.inspect()
app, k = runtime(); out['mullvad_switch'] = app.switch(tr.request())
app, k = runtime(); k.egress_ok = False; out['mullvad_unanswered'] = app.inspect()
app, k = runtime(); app.catalog.snapshot['fetched_at'] = tr.timestamp(86401); out['mullvad_pending_stale'] = app.switch(tr.request())
app, k = runtime(); write_json_atomic(app.desired_path, tr.request(server='xx-xxx-wg-999')); out['mullvad_rejected'] = app.tick()
app, k = runtime()
app.catalog.relays[tr.OTHER_HOST] = {**tr.ENTRY, 'hostname': tr.OTHER_HOST, 'public_key': tr.OTHER_KEY}
k.keys = [tr.OTHER_KEY]; k.fail_set = True
write_json_atomic(app.desired_path, tr.request()); out['mullvad_mutation_failed'] = app.tick()
app, k = runtime(); k.egress_ok = False; write_json_atomic(app.desired_path, tr.request()); out['mullvad_unverified'] = app.tick()
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
write_json_atomic(tmp/'applier'/'relays.json', {'fetched_at': now_iso(), 'relays': {tr.HOST: tr.ENTRY}})
kernel = tr.Kernel()
app = Applier(tmp, tr.CONFIG, run=kernel.run, clock=lambda: kernel.now, sleep=kernel.sleep, server=tr.HOST)
app.next_catalog = float('inf'); out['mullvad_configured'] = app.tick()
app, k = runtime(); write_json_atomic(app.desired_path, {'server': '--bad', 'requested_at': now_iso()}); out['mullvad_invalid_desired'] = app.tick()

def nord():
    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
    write_json_atomic(tmp/'applier'/'relays.json', {'fetched_at': now_iso(), 'provider': 'nordvpn', 'relays': tn.catalogue()}, public=True)
    kernel = tn.NordKernel()
    a = tn.NordApplier(tmp, tn.CONFIG, run=kernel.run, clock=lambda: kernel.now, sleep=kernel.sleep, boot_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa')
    a.next_catalog = float('inf')
    return a, kernel
a, k = nord(); out['nord_fresh'] = a.inspect()
a, k = nord(); out['nord_switch'] = a.switch(tn.request(tn.US))

def pia(forward):
    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
    secrets = tmp/'secrets'; secrets.mkdir(); (secrets/'username').write_text(tp.USERNAME+'\n'); (secrets/'password').write_text(tp.PASSWORD)
    write_json_atomic(tmp/'applier'/'relays.json', {'fetched_at': now_iso(), 'provider': 'pia', 'relays': {tp.REGION: tp.entry()}})
    kernel = tp.PiaKernel()
    kw = dict(port_forward=True, forward_target='192.0.2.10') if forward else {}
    a = tp.PiaApplier(tmp, tp.CONFIG, secrets_dir=secrets, run=kernel.run, clock=lambda: kernel.now, sleep=kernel.sleep, choose=lambda items: items[0], **kw)
    a.next_catalog = float('inf')
    return a, kernel
a, k = pia(False); out['pia_unregistered'] = a.inspect()
a, k = pia(True); tp.desire(a); a.tick(); out['pia_forward_bound'] = a.inspect()
a, k = pia(False); out['pia_switch'] = a.switch(tp.request())

spec = dataclasses.replace(providers.get('mullvad'), id='tunnelvpn', label='Tunnel Example', egress_tier='tunnel', validate_entry=lambda entry: dict(entry))
providers.REGISTRY['tunnelvpn'] = spec
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
write_json_atomic(tmp/'applier'/'relays.json', {'fetched_at': now_iso(), 'provider': 'tunnelvpn', 'relays': {tr.HOST: tr.ENTRY}})
kernel = te.EchoKernel()
a = te.TunnelApplier(tmp, tr.CONFIG, run=kernel.run, clock=lambda: kernel.now, sleep=kernel.sleep, boot_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa')
a.next_catalog = float('inf'); out['tunnel_tier'] = a.inspect()

# The gluetun backend (applier/gluetun_applier.py): the overlay exit and the sidecar kind.
def gl(provider='ivpn', **kw):
    return tg.make(Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()), provider, **kw)

a, k, g = gl(); out['gluetun_inspect'] = a.inspect()
a, k, g = gl(); out['gluetun_switch'] = a.switch(tg.request(tg.HOST_B))
a, k, g = gl('mullvad'); out['gluetun_mullvad'] = a.inspect()
a, k, g = gl('nordvpn'); out['gluetun_nordvpn'] = a.inspect()
a, k, g = gl(); k.tunnel = None; out['gluetun_no_tunnel'] = a.inspect()
a, k, g = gl(); g.fail = True; out['gluetun_refused'] = a.switch(tg.request(tg.HOST_B))
a, k, g = gl(); g.connect_to = tg.HOST_C; out['gluetun_elsewhere'] = a.switch(tg.request(tg.HOST_B))
a, k, g = gl(); k.egress = tg.HOST4; out['gluetun_host_address'] = a.inspect()
a, k, g = gl(); k.rules[6] = [r for r in k.rules[6] if r['priority'] != 88]; out['gluetun_guard_missing'] = a.switch(tg.request(tg.HOST_B))
a, k, g = gl(server=tg.HOST_B); out['gluetun_configured'] = a.tick()
a, k, g = gl(); write_json_atomic(a.desired_path, tg.request('four.example.test')); out['gluetun_rejected'] = a.tick()
a, k, g = gl(); a.save_selection(desired=tg.HOST_B, last_put=tg.HOST_B, last_successful=tg.HOST_B); k.tunnel = tg.HOST_A; a.next_health = float('inf'); out['gluetun_restore'] = a.tick()
a, k, g = tg.stale(Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())); a.update_servers(); out['gluetun_updating'] = a.inspect()
a, k, g = tg.stale(Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())); a.update_servers(); k.now += 99999; g.updater = 'crashed'
for _ in range(3):
    a.update_servers(); k.now += 400; a.update_servers(); k.now += 400; a.update_servers(); g.updater = 'crashed'
out['gluetun_update_failed'] = a.inspect()

a, k, g = tt.reconnecting(Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())); seen = []; real = a.publish
def record(status, message, **fields):
    result = real(status, message, **fields); seen.append(result); return result
a.publish = record
final = a.switch(tg.request(tg.HOST_B))
out['gluetun_reconnecting'] = next(r for r in seen if r['checks'].get('routing', {}).get('reason') == 'reconnecting')
out['gluetun_reconnecting_first'] = seen[0]
out['gluetun_reconnecting_final'] = final
out['gluetun_reconnecting_count'] = {'count': len(seen), 'statuses': [r['status'] for r in seen]}

def side(provider):
    return ts.make(Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()), provider)
a, k, g = side('nordvpn'); write_json_atomic(a.desired_path, tg.request(tg.HOST_B)); out['sidecar_provider'] = a.tick()
a, k, g = side('ivpn'); write_json_atomic(a.desired_path, tg.request(tg.HOST_B)); out['sidecar_tunnel'] = a.tick()
a, k, g = side('ivpn'); out['sidecar_fresh'] = a.inspect()
a, k, g = side('nordvpn'); k.tunnel = None; out['sidecar_no_tunnel'] = a.inspect()

Path('internal/applier/testdata/records_golden.json').write_text(json.dumps({k: json.dumps(v) for k, v in out.items()}, indent=1))
print(len(out), 'records')
